close_reason: Fixed: added Disposition::new(action_mode, sending_mode, type_) constructor; updated Mdn::new() doctest to use it
description: Mdn::new(disposition: Disposition) was just added, but Disposition is also #[non_exhaustive]. External crates cannot use struct literal syntax for Disposition, so Mdn::new() is effectively uncallable from outside jmap-mail-types. Trigger: any external crate that tries to use Mdn::new(). Bad behavior: compiler error E0639, no way to construct Mdn. Fix: add Disposition::new(action_mode, sending_mode, type_) constructor.
title: Disposition has no constructor — Mdn::new() is unusable from external crates
